title: "The Dark Corridor you feel you might not come back from" and "The Uncanny, bright staircase." I had them in the same dream an felt neither could be trusted.
content: Other than that the mall was nice. But when I talk about the corridor or staircase, I felt I wouldn't come back, not even in real life. And this dark corridor was endless, seemingly like a cartoon, going on into nothing. The staircase was nice, brigtend up but sun and the sun beamed in the windows, but felt like the title. It was a huge glass mall, quite relaxing the rest of it. No one was in there but me, and I can't exactly remember but it might have had a food court similar to the one in my town.
